rows.quote: dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
rows.reason_zh: 基础说明仍只指定一个敌方单位，新增的弹体间隔字段没有给基础技能增加目标。

rows.quote: one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target.
rows.reason_zh: 装备魔晶时，一次施法可用额外两枚弹体伤害原目标附近的其他敌人。

rows.quote: providing 325 vision around it. Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 弹体飞行时提供周围325范围的视野，命中后还提供目标区域3.34秒的视野。

rows.quote: Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.

rows.quote: dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
rows.reason_zh: 施法时仍以一个敌方单位为目标发射弹体。

rows.quote: Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
rows.reason_zh: 光弹命中后会对落点范围内的敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
rows.reason_zh: 光弹飞行时提供周围400范围的视野，命中后提供目标区域3.34秒的视野。

rows.quote: reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只写明命中后获得区域视野，没有使隐身单位显形的效果。

rows.quote: Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
rows.reason_zh: 光弹命中后仍会降低范围内敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.

rows.quote: distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 法术区域在持续时间内对其中的英雄造成伤害，符合场地魔法定义。

rows.quote: barrier_duration: 12→10
rows.reason_zh: 本次字段变更仅涉及护盾时长和额外智力，决定可破坏性的 IsBreakable 未变，沿用原判。

rows.quote: he gains bonus intelligence and a small magic damage barrier.
rows.reason_zh: 技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时仍能获得魔法伤害护盾，护盾时长由12秒缩至10秒。

rows.quote: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.

rows.quote: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.

rows.quote: your next attack will bash the target.
rows.reason_zh: 按给定机制定义，触发重击的那次攻击会眩晕目标。

rows.quote: stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放可对周围多个敌方单位造成伤害。

rows.quote: After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
rows.reason_zh: 受影响的敌人在眩晕结束后仍会被减速。

rows.quote: stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会眩晕附近的敌方单位。

rows.quote: When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.
rows.reason_zh: 敌方看不见斯拉克时，他仍可获得被动移速加成，受到中立单位伤害会暂时失去加成。

rows.quote: When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.
rows.reason_zh: 敌方看不见斯拉克时，他仍可获得额外生命恢复，受到中立单位伤害会暂时失去加成。

rows.quote: When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection.
rows.reason_zh: 主动施放后，斯拉克会隐去身形并免于侦测。

rows.quote: Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
rows.reason_zh: 敌人能看见云雾，斯拉克在其中攻击、施法或使用物品都不会显形。

rows.quote: any allies that come within %secondary_application_radius% range of them will also get the buff applied to them.
rows.reason_zh: 友军自行进入范围后获得增益，物品没有移动友军位置的效果。

rows.quote: bonus_movement_speed: 15→25
rows.reason_zh: 移速加成从15%提高到25%，装备加速的判断仍成立。

rows.quote: Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a %application_radius% radius invisible
rows.reason_zh: 使用者和施用范围内由友方玩家控制的单位仍会获得隐身。

rows.quote: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只按与敌人的距离提高伤害，没有写一次攻击会同时伤害多个敌人。
唯一变化的字段是 behavior，决定可破坏性的 IsBreakable 未变，沿用原来的否定判断。

rows.quote: rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage.
rows.reason_zh: 说明描述的是连续多次强化攻击，本次冷却调整没有给攻击增加范围伤害。

rows.quote: Each attack reduces the enemy's armor.
rows.reason_zh: 每次强化攻击仍会降低受击敌人的护甲。

rows.quote: Each attack reduces the enemy's armor.
rows.reason_zh: 减甲由每次强化攻击施加，符合攻击附带额外效果的定义。

rows.quote: Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time.
rows.reason_zh: 单次命中的伤害数值调整后，一次施法产生的火池仍可伤害区域内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time.
rows.reason_zh: 弹体落地后留下火池，持续对其中的敌人造成伤害和减速。

rows.quote: pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time.
rows.reason_zh: 火池仍能降低敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone.
rows.reason_zh: 一次射击仍可对锥形区域内的多个敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
rows.reason_zh: 基础说明明确列出攻击减速，并说明近距离命中会增强该效果。

rows.quote: Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
rows.reason_zh: 命中敌人仍会降低其移动速度，近距离命中还会增强减速。

rows.quote: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 暗杀仍锁定一个敌方单位，新增的 Item Potency 没有改变说明中的目标数量。

rows.quote: Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
rows.reason_zh: 狙击手击杀敌方英雄时仍会刷新暗杀的冷却。

rows.quote: Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
rows.reason_zh: 这句说明隐身无法躲开暗杀弹体，没有赋予施法者主动躲避来袭弹道的能力。

rows.quote: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
rows.reason_zh: A杖说明明确写有眩晕，这条否定判断在7.41f就已与原文冲突，7.42仍应判为有。

rows.quote: and mini-stuns the target.
rows.reason_zh: 基础暗杀仍会对目标造成小眩晕，符合眩晕定义。

rows.quote: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 狙击手施放暗杀时仍可直接选择一个敌方单位。

rows.quote: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.
rows.reason_zh: 每次攻击仍会根据狙击手与目标的距离附加伤害，符合攻击特效定义。
本次仅改动 behavior，决定可破坏性的 IsBreakable 未变，沿用原判。

rows.quote: showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement.
rows.reason_zh: 榴霰弹覆盖目标区域，可对其中的多个敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel
rows.reason_zh: 每次施放仍会消耗一点充能。

rows.quote: Provides vision in the targeted area.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍明确提供目标区域的视野。

rows.quote: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
rows.reason_zh: 目标区域在施放时立即造成伤害，随后每秒再次造成伤害，符合持续场地的定义。

rows.quote: Provides vision in the targeted area.
rows.reason_zh: 注释将揭示目标区域说明为提供视野，没有写到使隐身单位显形。
各等级的移动减速有所减弱，但数值仍全部为负，减速机制成立。

rows.quote: On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range.
rows.reason_zh: 施放后狙击手仍获得额外视野，视野范围限于前方锥形区域。

rows.quote: Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration
rows.reason_zh: 减速作用于狙击手自身，未满足降低敌方单位移速的定义。

rows.quote: a %absorb_amount% physical damage barrier.
rows.reason_zh: 主动效果仍提供物理伤害护盾，自施效力调整只涉及护甲、移速和攻速加成。

rows.quote: Bonus armor, movement and attack speed have %self_efficacy%%% effectiveness when cast on self.
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍可为友军加速，7.42还允许使用者自施时获得50%效力的移速加成。

rows.quote: if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
rows.reason_zh: 半径用于检查受击目标附近是否有其友军，额外伤害只作用于被攻击的孤立目标。

rows.quote: deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击孤立敌人时仍会附带额外纯粹伤害，符合攻击特效定义。

rows.quote: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
rows.reason_zh: 说明沿用旧版且字段变更清单为空，可被破坏的原判按 IsBreakable 未变保留。

rows.quote: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s
rows.reason_zh: 装备A杖后，首次对鬼影幻象使用 Reality 仍会使目标周围的敌人因恐惧而远离幽鬼。

rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会制造不可控的幻象追踪敌方英雄。

rows.quote: Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.
rows.reason_zh: 额外承伤描述的是鬼影幻象自身的属性，技能没有给被追踪的敌人施加伤害加深。

rows.quote: The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
rows.reason_zh: 幽鬼仍可通过子技能 Reality 主动传送到幻象所在位置。

rows.quote: and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 装备A杖后，首次对鬼影幻象使用 Reality 仍会降低目标周围敌人的移速。

rows.quote: They ignore terrain.
rows.reason_zh: 基础说明明确赋予鬼影幻象无视地形的移动能力。

rows.quote: Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会派出一个不可控的幻象追踪并攻击目标。

rows.quote: The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
rows.reason_zh: 幽鬼仍能通过子技能 Reality 传送至幻象所在位置。

rows.quote: Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.
rows.reason_zh: 施法时指定一个敌方目标，幻象随后追踪并攻击该目标。
